select p.qd, p.exp, p.expname, p.liab, p.liabname, p.amt, p.book, to_char(p.qd::date, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from p.qd::date)::int + 543)::text qdth,
 extract(month from p.qd::date)::int::text pm, yy.y yce,
 '^(' || left(yy.y, 1) || ',?' || substr(yy.y, 2) || '|' || left(yy.yb, 1) || ',?' || substr(yy.yb, 2) || ')$' yre,
 '^' || to_char(p.qd::date, 'DD/MM/') || '(' || yy.y || '|' || yy.yb || ')$' dre,
 x.vat::text vat, x.wht::text wht, (p.amt::numeric + x.vat)::text tot, (p.amt::numeric + x.vat - x.wht)::text cr,
 to_char(p.amt::numeric, 'FM999,999,999,990.00') amtc, to_char(x.wht, 'FM999,999,999,990.00') whtc,
 i.code inv, i.nm invname, w.code wacc, w.nm wname, s.code sup, s.nm supname, s.addr supaddr, s.st supst, s.tax suptax, s.card supcard
from (with qd as (
 select g::date as qd from generate_series((now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date - 40, (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date - 3, interval '1 day') g
 where not exists (select 1 from gl_journal_detail x where x.doc_date = g::date)
   and exists (select 1 from erp_account_period p where g::date between p.date_start and p.date_end and coalesce(p.status, 0) = 0)
 order by g desc limit 1),
leaf as (select c.code, coalesce(c.name_1, '') nm, c.account_type t from gl_chart_of_account c where not exists (select 1 from gl_chart_of_account k where k.main_code = c.code)),
used as (select l.code, l.nm, l.t, count(*) n, (array_agg(d.debit order by d.doc_date desc, d.roworder desc) filter (where d.debit > 0))[1] lastdr
 from leaf l join gl_journal_detail d on d.account_code = l.code and d.doc_no not like 'UAT%' group by 1, 2, 3)
select to_char(q.qd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') qd, e.code exp, e.nm expname, a.code liab, a.nm liabname, round(e.lastdr, 2)::text amt, (round(e.lastdr, 2) + 1)::text bad, b.code book
from qd q,
 (select * from used where t = 4 and lastdr > 0 order by n desc, code limit 1) e,
 (select code, coalesce(name_1, '') nm from gl_chart_of_account, (values (0, '2111'), (1, '2110'), (2, '2100')) p(o, c)
 where code = p.c or code like p.c || '-%' order by p.o, (code = p.c) desc, code limit 1) a,
 (select code from gl_journal_book order by code limit 1) b) p
 cross join lateral (select extract(year from p.qd::date)::int::text y, (extract(year from p.qd::date)::int + 543)::text yb) yy
 cross join lateral (select round(p.amt::numeric * 7 / 100, 2) vat, round(p.amt::numeric * 3 / 100, 2) wht) x
 cross join (select code, coalesce(name_1, '') nm from gl_chart_of_account, (values (0, '1154'), (1, '1151'), (2, '1155'), (3, '1190')) p(o, c)
 where code = p.c or code like p.c || '-%' order by p.o, (code = p.c) desc, code limit 1) i
 cross join (select code, coalesce(name_1, '') nm from gl_chart_of_account, (values (0, '2122'), (1, '2123'), (2, '2120')) p(o, c)
 where code = p.c or code like p.c || '-%' order by p.o, (code = p.c) desc, code limit 1) w
 cross join (select m.code, coalesce(m.name_1, '') nm, coalesce(m.address, '') addr, coalesce(m.ap_status, 0)::text st, coalesce(d.tax_id, '') tax, coalesce(d.card_id, '') card
  from ap_supplier m left join ap_supplier_detail d on d.ap_code = m.code
  where m.code not like 'UAT%' and coalesce(m.name_1, '') <> '' and (select count(*) from ap_supplier_detail k where k.ap_code = m.code) <= 1
  order by (coalesce(m.status, 0) = 0) desc, (coalesce(d.tax_id, '') <> '') desc, m.code limit 1) s
